_comment: Evidence that code has been checked on a platform other than the one this
tool runs on. Without an entry, platforms a declaration's #if allows are
only claimed. A source is either a script whose quoted Sources/ and Tests/
paths are the files it checks (kind: script), or an explicit list of
files (kind: files). Add an entry when a lane builds or runs code off
Darwin, with the level it reached: typechecked, built, or tested.

sources.detail: compiled on macOS against LinuxModel.h, a model of glibc's and Bionic's declarations, through SIL; not built with a real C library, and not run
